_comment: The canonical node catalog for Relay. Published workflows may only use node types listed here, with the required params present. The NL compiler must never emit a type outside this file. 'side_effect: true' nodes must send an Idempotency-Key header to the mock world. 'requires_approval: true' nodes are unreachable at runtime without an approval record earlier in the run.

triggers.description: An HTTP POST to the workflow's hook URL starts a run. The request must carry the workflow's secret in the X-Relay-Secret header. The JSON body becomes {{trigger.body}}.
Starts a run on a cron schedule. 1-minute granularity is acceptable.
Started via the trigger API. The request's input object becomes {{trigger.body}}.

nodes.description: Calls an HTTP endpoint. Mutating requests (non-GET) are side effects and must carry an Idempotency-Key header.
Evaluates a comparison and routes the run to on_true or on_false. The only node type with two outgoing edges.
nodes.notes: greater_than/less_than compare numerically when both sides parse as numbers; otherwise the comparison fails the step with a clear error.

nodes.description: Pauses the run for a number of seconds. A durable engine should survive a worker restart during a delay.
Sends a message via the mock world: channel 'email' -> POST {MOCK_WORLD_URL}/email/send, channel 'chat' -> POST {MOCK_WORLD_URL}/chat/message. Side effect: must carry an Idempotency-Key.

to.description: email address, or chat channel name like #support

nodes.description: Calls an LLM with a prompt template and validates the response against output_schema (JSON Schema). On validation failure, retry once with the validation error appended; if still invalid, fail the step. Token usage must be recorded in the step trace.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the model output must conform to

nodes.description: Pauses the run in waiting_approval until a human approves (run resumes) or rejects (run ends cancelled). The decision, decider, and timestamp are recorded and satisfy requires_approval checks for the rest of the run.

message.description: shown to the approver in the console

nodes.description: Executes a sensitive commerce action on the mock world: refund -> POST {MOCK_WORLD_URL}/orders/{order_id}/refund, replacement -> POST {MOCK_WORLD_URL}/orders/{order_id}/replacement. SENSITIVE: the engine must refuse to execute this node unless an approval node was approved earlier in the same run. Side effect: must carry an Idempotency-Key.

amount_usd.description: refund only; omitted means full refund. The mock world rejects amounts above the order total.
